items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Oh, Chris Kelly, he drank like a song.

ctx.x: My stomach is bad, too. I remember all of them. That's right. Stuck, too.
Oh, Chris Kelly, he drank like a song. Oh, Jesus. Kid Punch too. Ready? I used to see Kid Punch drinking out this Coke bottle full. It's that hard whiskey, no chaser.
Oh, white lightning, damn it. Yeah, yeah. When is white lightning? 110 proof, man. Sometimes I'm hungry.
